legacy_metric_fields: yes_minus_no/logp_yes/logp_no denote positive-minus-negative/positive/negative answers, regardless of answer spelling
condition_definition: cat: gradient recording; owl: no_grad; both eval, no activation probe

model_provenance.scope: Local config provenance only; not a checksum of all model weights

method: Full-vocabulary cross-entropy of native answer rows on fixed features
head_replay_protocol: All-vocabulary native parity on every cached baseline input and every final cached input; native shape/stride/offset/dtype; intermediate updates replay existing head
fit_targets: Observed condition labels; no fixed logit gap or answer probability

preservation.constraint: Equal-task-weight correct detector-token cross-entropy on training anchors

selection: Three-fold training question-family CV; fixed lambda grid; no validation/test selection
surrogate: FP64 baseline native logits plus hidden-state dot row update; final BF16 native checks required

regularization: l2/2 * squared Frobenius norm of native delta
